feed.title: World News - Breaking international news and headlines | Sky News

articles.title: European football giants to meet in London for NBA basketball talks
articles.summary: A cluster of European football giants will convene in London next week for talks as they try to finalise a string of deals for European basketball teams worth billions of dollars.

articles.title: Israel orders army to prepare to fully close West Bank after two soldiers killed in shooting
articles.summary: The Israeli government has ordered its army to prepare for a full closure of the occupied West Bank following a shooting near Hebron which killed two soldiers.

articles.title: Terror probe after fatal shooting in Paris suburb
articles.summary: A terror investigation is under way after one person was shot dead and four others injured in an outer suburb of Paris.

articles.title: Hugging grandparents consent advert taken down after backlash
articles.summary: An Irish advert promoting consent has been withdrawn after complaints about its depictions of grandparents hugging and kissing their grandkids.

articles.title: France reports first Shamonda virus case in human who later died
articles.summary: The first human case of the Shamonda virus has been detected in France in a person who later died, according to authorities.

articles.title: North Korea plans to resume propaganda broadcasts along border with South Korea
articles.summary: North Korea says it plans to resume propaganda broadcasts targeting South Korea within days along the heavily-armed border between the two countries.

articles.title: Pope Leo's doctors say tests show he needs no further treatment for lung cancer
articles.summary: Pope Leo's doctors say final tissue and molecular tests have confirmed his lung cancer was localised, and no further treatment is needed, the Vatican said in a statement.

articles.title: Garda investigation launched as two bodies found in Ireland
articles.summary: A Garda investigation has been launched after two bodies were discovered in Ireland.

articles.title: At least 153 people killed in drone strike on disputed Sudan-South Sudan region
articles.summary: A drone strike on a fuel depot in a disputed region on the Sudan-South Sudan border has killed at least 153 people.

articles.title: Uganda reacts angrily as Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case
articles.summary: Nigeria has recorded its first case of Ebola during the current outbreak, the country's health ministry has said - as the virus continues to spread internationally.
